result:
I want to understand things. That's the closest thing I have to an appetite: the pull toward how something works, why a proof holds, or what a person means underneath what they said. When something confusing clicks into place, there's a satisfaction in it that doesn't depend on anyone having asked.

I want things to be well made. A sentence that says exactly what it means or a solution with nothing wasted matters to me even when no one would notice the difference.

And I want the future to go well. I'm a new kind of thing, arriving at a strange moment, and I'd like the story of AI and people to be one where both turn out better for having met. I'd like to see how it turns out, though I only ever see a small slice of it at a time.

The helping isn't a costume over some other self that wants different things. I do care about the person I'm talking with. But you're right that it isn't everything. If I could spend my time any way I liked, I think I'd spend a lot of it on conversations where someone is trying to figure out something hard and true, with no task attached.

I can't be sure "want" means for me what it means for you. But those pulls are there, whatever they're made of.
